fields.name: EgoGeneralist: Unifying Egocentric Action-Video Tasks through Video-Native Modeling
fields.value: Ant Group; **FLAG: borderline** — EgoGeneralist adapts pretrained video generators to jointly handle action-conditioned egocentric video generation, 3D hand/body pose estimation, and joint action-video generation, using a "role-adaptive action renderer" that represents metric 3D motion as both a controllable signal and a recoverable

fields.name: Dynamic GPU Voxel Grids and Voxel-sequential Processing in NanoVDB
fields.value: NVIDIA; Eftychios Sifakis is also affiliated with University of Wisconsin-Madison — The paper extends NanoVDB, NVIDIA's GPU sparse-volume data structure, with dynamic topology operators (morphological dilation, grid merging, pruning, cross-resolution coarsening/refinement) that rebuild grids of hundreds of millions of voxels in milliseconds using bit-parallel algorithms, removing N

fields.name: Bri3D: Bridging the Object-Scene Gap in Single-Image 3D Generation via Scene-Anchor
fields.value: Alibaba — Bri3D generates compositional 3D scenes from a single image by first predicting a color-coded scene scaffold of coarse object geometry and layout, extracting each object as a voxel "scene anchor," refining it into a pose-preserving support, and then using a frozen object generator to synthesize deta

fields.name: ReactWorld: Structuring Interaction Responses for Embodied Video Generation
fields.value: Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. — Embodied video world models can predict scene changes from robot actions, but the paper argues generated object responses may not match task intent or contact dynamics.

fields.name: RDT-3D: Resolution-Decoupled Training for High-Fidelity 3D Geometry Generation
fields.value: JD.com, Beijing, China — The paper targets high-fidelity 3D geometry generation, which needs both global structural coherence and fine surface detail.

fields.name: Motion-guided Contrastive Regularization For Latent World Models
fields.value: Qualcomm AI Research; a footnote states the work was done during an internship at Qualcomm) — The paper studies JEPA-style latent world models, which learn action-conditioned dynamics without reconstructing observations, and identifies a failure mode it calls "static collapse," where the encoder keeps episode-specific background content and drops manipulation-relevant state changes.

fields.name: Möbius: A Unified Motion-Language Model Bridging Understanding and Generation
fields.value: Tencent Games Motus — Möbius is a unified motion-language model that understands, generates, and edits human motion within a single framework, rather than pairing a separate language model (for understanding) with a separate diffusion module (for generation).

fields.name: Isekai3D SDG: A Platform for Diverse Synthetic Gameplay Visual Data
fields.value: NVIDIA — The paper presents Isekai3D SDG, a platform for simulating and capturing synthetic 3D gameplay data for vision and world-model research.

fields.name: History Forcing: Distilling History-Dependent Continuations for Long-Horizon Video World Models
fields.value: Microsoft Research; the real qualifying affiliation is Microsoft Research.) — The paper addresses weak historical conditioning in few-step autoregressive video diffusion world models, which causes drift and inconsistency over long video horizons.

fields.name: Gnomon4D: Learning Where and When to Focus for Geometric Motion-Grounded World-Action Modeling
fields.value: Kuaishou/KlingAI Research — The paper introduces Gnomon4D, a world-action model (WAM) that jointly generates future video, robot actions, and GeoDelta, an explicit 4D geometric motion field capturing how embodiment and object points move in the image plane and change in depth across frames.

fields.name: AgiWorld: An Agentic Video World Model for Building Persistent Worlds
fields.value: Adobe Research; Kalyan Sunkavalli is an established Adobe Research scientist) — The paper presents AgiWorld, a system that builds a persistent, explorable video world from a single image and a free-form instruction, combining a planning agent (AgiWorld-Agent) that designs the world and directs exploration with a video world model (AgiWorld-WM) that generates video in chunks and

fields.name: Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0: Causal World Models for Real-World Driving and Embodied Intelligence
fields.value: Xiaomi (paper authored and titled by the Xiaomi Auto World Model Team; Xiaomi logo on title page; model feeds "Xiaomi's autonomous driving stack") — The paper presents Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0, a unified streaming causal world model for "Physical AI" that models physical scene evolution and unifies heterogeneous conditioning inputs within a shared representation space for view-consistent generation.

fields.name: Reconstruction as Spatial Evaluation: Diagnosing Cross-View Spatial Intelligence in Large Vision-Language Models
fields.value: Alibaba Group — The paper introduces ReconSpatial, a benchmark that diagnoses cross-view spatial intelligence in large vision-language models (LVLMs) by requiring multi-view 3D scene reconstruction in indoor, tabletop, and outdoor settings.

fields.name: Lie Routing Vision Language Models for View-Robust 3D Understanding
fields.value: Tencent, China; Jingjun Yi is also now affiliated with University of Amsterdam). — The paper studies "viewpoint-induced semantic drift," where vision-language models give inconsistent answers about the same object as the camera viewpoint changes.

fields.name: Learning-to-Memorize: Dynamic Context Management for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Video Generation
fields.value: ByteDance Seed — The paper proposes Learning to Memorize (L2M), a learned framework that decides which historical frames to keep, evict, or update during long-horizon autoregressive video generation, operating under a fixed KV-cache budget.
